name: Advanced Accounts – Email / Phone Verifications / OTP Login for WooCommerce
author: YoOhw.com

sections.description:
Advanced Accounts – Email / Phone Verifications / OTP Login for WooCommerce is a powerful WooCommerce extension designed to enhance your customer account management by adding modern, mobile-first features. This plugin provides seamless registration and login experiences, making it easier and more secure for users to access their accounts.

Features

  • Phone Number Registration: Allow users to create accounts using their phone number instead of traditional email-based registration.
  • Login with OTP (One-Time Password): Simplify and secure the login process by letting users log in with a one-time password sent to their verified phone number or email address.
  • Phone Number Verification: Ensure user authenticity by requiring phone number verification during registration or account updates.
  • Email Address Verification: Optionally verify email addresses to maintain clean and trustworthy user data.
  • Password Reset by OTP: Users easily receive a verification code to reset their password using the phone number or email address.
  • Customizable User Experience: Easily integrate and style the features to match your WooCommerce store’s design.

With WooCommerce Advanced Accounts, you can reduce barriers to account creation, improve user security, and increase engagement with an intuitive and reliable verification system. Perfect for businesses looking to embrace mobile-first solutions or enhance their WooCommerce account management.

External Services

This plugin uses SMS Credits by YoOhw, an API service managed by us, to send SMS-based One-Time Passwords (OTPs) for phone number verification during login and registration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload Plugin: Upload the wc-advanced-accounts folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Prerequisites: Ensure that WooCommerce is installed and activated.
sections.faq:
Q: How does phone number registration work?

A: When a user registers on your WooCommerce store, they can enter their phone number instead of an email address. The plugin validates the phone number format and ensures it is verified before completing the registration process.

Q: Can users still register with an email address?

A: Yes, you can configure the plugin to allow registration using either a phone number or an email address, depending on your store’s requirements.

Q: What is OTP login, and how does it improve security?

A: OTP (One-Time Password) login generates a unique code sent to the user’s verified phone number for authentication. This ensures only the user with access to the registered phone number can log in, offering a secure and hassle-free experience.

Q: Does the plugin support both phone and email verification?

A: Yes, the plugin supports phone number verification and email address verification. You can enable one or both methods to suit your store’s needs.

Q: Is the phone verification process customizable?

A: Yes, you can customize the messages sent during phone verification, including the OTP message format. The plugin also allows integration with popular SMS services for sending verification codes.

Q: Is this plugin compatible with all WooCommerce themes?

A: Yes, WC Advanced Accounts is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme. It also provides hooks and settings for easy customization.
